title: When banjo players started making ninth chords
summary: Vincent says he used ninths after banjo and guitar parts appeared in orchestra music, after World War I; Keto played them and a pianist tested him with chords.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
